# Original unplayed posthand escrow

Run `bash scripts/dev/probe-posthand-escrow-pg17.sh` with PostgreSQL 17. The probe uses an isolated private Unix-socket cluster and never accepts a remote connection. On macOS every temporary file is on the mounted external SSD. Set `POSTHAND_ESCROW_EVIDENCE_DIR` to retain server/refusal logs.

Captured hand 31008564 has original poker deltas +56.25 and -60, with rake 3.75. A separate original 368.62 wallet debit applied after the signed hand, taking felt 215.53 to 584.15. The historical outcome omitted one earning owner because funding application was still pending at capture. An exact original immutable completion certificate permits an explicit financial projection; the deposit never becomes winnings. Original outcome, manifest, provenance, roster, accepted hashes and monetary records remain unchanged.

The native probe demonstrates fail-before/pass-after using actual captured rows, original predecessor, signed request, wallet funding, transaction frame and seat-event authority. It exercises 28 financial/source counterexamples, forged and NULL/stale projections, NULL/malformed/wrong admission pins, freeze, active reader ownership, rolled-back installation, deterministic concurrent admission, immutable certificate update/delete/truncate refusal, duplicate/refused replay, private access, exact postimages and raw-absence proof with all remaining originals. Raw and shaped hand lines both count original deltas once. The actual report monetary CTE runs an explicit single-hand boundary construction, not a claim that a complete historical weekly boundary is certified.

The retained private owner functions and all ordinary public financial clauses are byte-identical. The actual unchanged pruner refuses this uncertified original and preserves p/m. Eight days does not authorize pruning uncertified originals. Raw-absence qualification is a strict financial durability test, not production disposal permission or global pruner readiness. This change neither rebuilds original payload nor invents pending IDs.

The existing Accounting shard 3 directly executes this probe and always retains its artifact. Source binding pins every native input. Production installation and the one exact certificate admission remain separate, guarded delivery steps.

The finite certificate PK is joined set-wise in both hand-line routes. An actual prior-candidate query counterexample demonstrates the per-shaped-row original lookup;10000 cache-only uncertified shaped inputs then prove exact ordinary participant retention without original lookup. The real certified hand still projects both+56.25/−60 once and all corrupted certified-row refusals remain.

The temporal successor also runs in this same maintained route, in a fresh isolated database. New rows are deterministic synthetic mutations of the existing retained fixture. It proves rebuy, partial/full refunds, every affected participant, during-hand pending arrivals, multiple applications in one transaction and first-occupancy single-addon admission. Negative cases preserve exact refund identity/original transaction snapshots, application timing/occupancy, seat-event order and predecessor atomic stacks. The actual completion owner and certificate writer prove own-event admission, retained read, replay and financial completion with visible expected reporting refusal; unexpected SQL errors roll back.

Its private scalar predecessor lookup preserves every original candidate predicate and nearest-hand ordering, including invalid future-accepted predecessors. Native plans compare the hot-key custom-plan counterexample with the table/time/key index-only generic plan, then execute the actual function and prove caller planner settings restore on success and error. The maintained migration's exact concurrent preamble and entire transaction run with missing-index/ACL/stale-pin/source refusals, rollback, installation and replay. This isolated seam supplies explicit reporting-readiness and generation adapters; it does not fabricate a production 68-source certificate. Production installation and finite original certificate admissions remain separate protected operations.

On macOS the probe checks the actual configured scratch volume (default SSD2), rather than assuming its SSD1 parent is mounted. `POSTHAND_ESCROW_SCRATCH_ROOT` may select an existing task-owned directory on an identified external SSD. No remote database input is accepted.

Direct prehand addons without pending IDs also require their original posted debit, funding frame and complete same-occupancy seat-event chain, aggregated with any pending credits in that transaction. The connected synthetic direct-credit case proves the original played opening and refuses forged occupancy or event amount. Private source-cohort replays stay outside this public fixture.
